as_told.title: McConnell recalls a source visibly shaking

plain: A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says that people who came to Capitol Hill to tell Senate staff what they knew about secret UFO matters were sometimes so frightened that one was visibly shaking as they began to explain. McConnell tells Michels this from his own time hearing such sources, and on a later episode, when the host prompts him, he describes them more generally as earnest people with credible backgrounds who were "nervous and they're shaking." To him, that fear suggests the people were telling the truth about something dangerous to reveal.
